title: Our Best Cheesecake
description: Classic Philadelphia cream cheese cheesecake with a graham cracker crust, sour cream, and optional cherry pie topping, transcribed from a vintage recipe clipping.
time: 1 hour 10 minutes baking, plus at least 4 hours chilling

items: 1¾ cups HONEY MAID Graham Cracker Crumbs
⅓ cup margarine or butter, melted
¼ cup sugar (from the 1¼ cups total)
3 packages (8 ounces each) PHILADELPHIA Cream Cheese, softened
1 cup sugar (remaining from the 1¼ cups total)
1 cup BREAKSTONE'S or KNUDSEN Sour Cream

steps.title: Preheat the oven
steps.text: Preheat oven to 350°F for a silver 8- or 9-inch springform pan, or 325°F for a dark nonstick 8- or 9-inch springform pan.

steps.title: Make the crust
steps.text: Mix graham cracker crumbs, melted margarine or butter, and ¼ cup of the sugar. Press firmly onto the bottom and 2½ inches up the sides of the springform pan. Set aside.

steps.title: Beat the filling
steps.text: Beat softened cream cheese, the remaining 1 cup sugar, and vanilla in a large bowl with an electric mixer on high speed until well blended. Add eggs, one at a time, mixing on low speed after each addition just until blended. Add sour cream. Pour into crust.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake 1 hour to 1 hour 10 minutes, or until the center is almost set. Turn off the oven. Leaving the door slightly ajar, leave the cheesecake in the oven for 1 hour.

steps.title: Chill and serve
steps.text: Remove from oven and cool completely. Refrigerate 4 hours or overnight. Remove the side of the pan; top with cherry pie filling, if desired. Refrigerate leftover cheesecake.

notes.Original clipping: Prep: 15 minutes plus refrigerating. Bake: 1 hour 10 minutes. Makes 16 servings. The optional cherry pie filling is added after chilling.
notes.Source: Transcribed from the photographed 'OUR BEST CHEESECAKE' vintage Philadelphia cream cheese recipe clipping.
